Total revenue increased at a modest pace, driven primarily by strong performance in the company\u2019s core markets. Net income also rose, bolstered by favorable tax conditions and reduced interest expenses due to a restructuring of long-term debt. The company managed to reduce its financial leverage, leading to an improvement in its interest coverage ratio.
